naming_clarity.reason: Title and body use plain stakeholder language (fleet operator, cell, pack, charge session, workshop, usable capacity); cell voltages converging into a narrow band is something a non-implementer can confirm with a voltmeter.

no_mechanism_leak.reason: Names no class, function, module, table, endpoint or technology, and states what happens (charge evened out) without saying how (no balancing method, circuit or algorithm).

parent_fit.reason: Root of the V: the user_stories stage has no upstream stage (depends_on is empty) and the story has no outgoing trace link, so there is no parent to engage with and the axis is fully met by default.

single_user_capability.reason: Exactly one capability, the pack evening out the charge between its cells on its own; the out-of-scope paragraph explicitly excludes protection, charge reporting and temperature regulation, and its one child requirement covers only this.

user_observable.reason: Names the observer (a workshop), the condition (resting pack, a stated time after a charge session ends) and the visible result (cell voltages converged into a narrow band instead of fanned out), all checkable without reading source or logs.

summary: Single, observable, implementation-free story with a clear workshop check; fully meets every axis (parent_fit met by default as the root of the V).
